 metadata_results: profiles/default/metadata_results.ivvecs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="490" x="40" y="830" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="invbox" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Ordinal referencing invariants (BQGDMPR)
• three ordinal spaces — base (B and M rows), query (Q and G rows), predicate (P and R rows)
• row alignment within each space: M[i] describes b[i] · G[i] answers q[i] · R[j] lists the matches of P[j]
• value references across spaces: G cells and R cells are base ordinals ∈ [0, N)
• D (neighbor_distances.fvecs) is cell-for-cell aligned with G
• R records are variable-length (.ivvecs) — random access requires the IDXFOR__ offset sidecar
• R[j] = { i : M[i] ⊨ P[j] } — produced by compute evaluate-predicates; verified by SQLite re-evaluation
• downstream derivations: B+Q+R → F (prefiltered GT) · G+D+R → E (postfiltered GT)
(spec: 01-data-model.md §1.5 · prefilter-postfilter-facets.md)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="860" x="570" y="830" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

# dataset.yaml (BQGDMPR view)
profiles:
default:
maxk: 100
base_vectors: profiles/base/base_vectors.fvecs
query_vectors: profiles/base/query_vectors.fvecs
neighbor_indices: profiles/default/neighbor_indices.ivecs
neighbor_distances: profiles/default/neighbor_distances.fvecs
metadata_content: profiles/base/metadata_content.slab
metadata_predicates: profiles/base/predicates.slab
metadata_results: profiles/default/metadata_results.ivvecs

div.div:
Ordinal referencing invariants (BQGDMPR)
• three ordinal spaces — base (B and M rows), query (Q and G rows), predicate (P and R rows)
• row alignment within each space: M[i] describes b[i] · G[i] answers q[i] · R[j] lists the matches of P[j]
• value references across spaces: G cells and R cells are base ordinals ∈ [0, N)
• D (neighbor_distances.fvecs) is cell-for-cell aligned with G
• R records are variable-length (.ivvecs) — random access requires the IDXFOR__ offset sidecar
• R[j] = { i : M[i] ⊨ P[j] } — produced by compute evaluate-predicates; verified by SQLite re-evaluation
• downstream derivations: B+Q+R → F (prefiltered GT) · G+D+R → E (postfiltered GT)
(spec: 01-data-model.md §1.5 · prefilter-postfilter-facets.md)
